# Educative

> Educative is an AI-powered interactive learning platform for developers offering courses in generative AI, system design, cloud certifications, and technical interview preparation.

Educative provides hands-on, interactive courses designed to help developers master modern technologies including LLMs, agentic AI systems, AWS cloud services, and coding fundamentals. The platform combines AI-assisted feedback with practical labs and real-world project experience.

## Key Topics

- Generative AI
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Agentic Systems
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)
- System Design
- AWS Cloud
- Claude Code
- Llama Stack
- Interview Preparation
- Prompt Engineering
- Multi-Agent Systems
- Interactive Learning
- Cloud Certifications
- Full-Stack Development

## AI & Generative AI Fundamentals

- [Generative AI Essentials - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/generative-ai-essentials): Foundational course on LLMs, NLP, and generative AI ethics
- [Essentials of Large Language Models: A Beginner's Journey](https://www.educative.io/courses/essentials-of-large-language-models-a-beginners-journey): Beginner course on LLM fundamentals, RAG, embeddings, and prompting
- [Agentic System Design - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/agentic-ai-systems): Course on designing autonomous AI agents and multi-agent systems
- [Agentic System Design Crash Course - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/agentic-system-design-crash-course): 8-hour crash course on AI agent design and agentic architectures

## AI Development & Tools

- [Claude Code: Workflows and Tools - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/claude-code): Course on Claude Code AI development with Anthropic models and GitHub
- [Mastering MCP: Building Advanced Agentic Applications](https://www.educative.io/courses/advanced-model-context-protocol): Advanced course on Model Context Protocol for agentic AI applications
- [Llama Stack: From Fundamentals to Deployment - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/llamastack): Course on Llama Stack with RAG, agentic workflows, and deployment
- [Advanced Windsurf AI for Professionals - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/advanced-windsurf-ai-for-professionals): Full-stack development with Windsurf AI, Cascade, and JavaScript

## Technical Interview & System Design

- [Tech Interview Prep: Get Hired](https://www.educative.io/interview): Interview prep hub with coding, system design, and AI-assisted feedback
- [Grokking the Mobile System Design Interview](https://www.educative.io/courses/mobile-system-design): Mobile system design interview prep with architecture patterns

## Cloud & AWS Certifications

- [AWS Solutions Architect Associate](https://www.educative.io/courses/aws-solutions-architect-associate): AWS SAA-C03 certification prep with hands-on Cloud Labs
- [Master AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner CLF-C02 Exam](https://www.educative.io/courses/aws-certified-cloud-practitioner-exam): AWS Cloud Practitioner certification prep with practice exams

## Programming Fundamentals

- [Learn Java from Scratch - Free AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/learn-java-from-scratch): Free beginner Java course with fundamentals and hands-on projects
- [Learn Intermediate SQL - AI-Powered Course](https://www.educative.io/courses/learn-intermediate-sql): Intermediate SQL course covering queries, joins, and aggregations

## Core Platform

- [Educative: AI-Powered Interactive Courses for Developers](https://www.educative.io): Educative homepage: AI-powered interactive learning platform for developers
